identity_check: Confirmed as SymphonyAI Industrial, the industrial business of SymphonyAI (symphonyai.com/industrial; President Prateek Kathpal, 'President of Industrial at SymphonyAI'). It was created when SymphonyAI acquired Industrial Global, a machine condition-monitoring and reliability provider, renamed SymphonyAI Industrial (SymphonyAI release, 15 May 2019). Not SymX.ai (a Sudbury, Ontario startup that surfaced in search) and not the parent SymphonyAI / SAIGroup as a whole. Parent funding is NOT recorded: the only capital found is Dr. Romesh Wadhwani's '$1 billion commitment' to the SymphonyAI group (2020 group brochure; 2023 release), which is not attributable to the industrial unit, and CB Insights lists no funding rounds for SymphonyAI Industrial. The unit's own deals are outbound acquisitions (Savigent, March 2021; Proceedix, Dec 2021 per CB Insights) and are not funding. Category kept adjacent, layer plant_ops: the unit sells an industrial data platform (IRIS Foundry), asset performance management, process optimization copilots and AI agents (Intelligent Factory, Frontline Worker, Manufacturing Digital Twin) to large manufacturers and energy firms; this overlaps Utopian's maintenance and process-stability agents but as an enterprise suite delivered via Teams / M365 Copilot rather than procurement / RFQ agents over WhatsApp.

open_items: No funding rounds of the industrial unit found; total raised not applicable. Parent SymphonyAI is backed by 'a $1 billion commitment' from Dr. Romesh Wadhwani (group-level, not attributable to Industrial), so nothing was recorded from the parent.

Founded year left null: the SymphonyAI Industrial name dates from the May 2019 acquisition, but Industrial Global built its solutions 'over the past decade'; its founding year was not found. No founders for the unit (SymphonyAI group founded by Dr. Romesh Wadhwani).
Headcount not published for the unit; parent cited '3,000' people in Oct 2023. Not recorded.
Revenue not reported for the unit; parent expected its 2023 revenue run rate to 'approach $500M' (a run-rate expectation for the whole group). Not recorded.
Outbound acquisitions by the unit: Savigent (SymphonyAI release, 9 March 2021, terms not stated) and Proceedix (CB Insights only, 21 Dec 2021). Not recorded as rounds.
No 2025-2026 sale, spin-out or funding of the industrial unit found in the pages and searches run on 2026-10-30.
